panels.title: Instance availability & collection health
panels.description: One row per monitored instance. STALE = no sample for more than 35 minutes; DEGRADED = at least one failed collector run in the last hour.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT server_name, last_sample_at, sample_age_seconds, last_run_status,
                      runs_24h, failures_24h, health_state
               FROM mon.v_collection_health ORDER BY server_name
SELECT count(*) AS "Issues" FROM mon.v_collection_health WHERE health_state <> 'HEALTHY'
SELECT count(*) AS "Critical" FROM mon.v_active_alerts WHERE server_name = '$server' AND severity = 'critical'
SELECT count(*) AS "Warnings" FROM mon.v_active_alerts WHERE server_name = '$server' AND severity = 'warning'
SELECT runs_24h AS "Runs" FROM mon.v_collection_health WHERE server_name = '$server'
SELECT failures_24h AS "Errors" FROM mon.v_collection_health WHERE server_name = '$server'
SELECT count(*) AS "Databases" FROM mon.db_inventory WHERE server_name = '$server' AND collected_at = (SELECT max(collected_at) FROM mon.db_inventory WHERE server_name = '$server')

panels.title: Active alerts
panels.description: Computed from the latest snapshots (see postgres/03_dashboard_views.sql). An alert disappears by itself when the condition clears.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT alerted_at, severity, metric_name, object_name, message
                FROM mon.v_active_alerts WHERE server_name = '$server'
                ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 0 WHEN 'warning' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, alerted_at DESC

SELECT collected_at AS time, sql_cpu_pct AS "SQL Server", other_cpu_pct AS "Other processes"
                     FROM mon.cpu_usage WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND server_name = '$server' ORDER BY 1

SELECT collected_at AS time, os_total_mb - os_available_mb AS "OS used",
                            sql_memory_used_mb AS "SQL Server", max_server_memory_mb AS "max server memory"
                     FROM mon.memory_usage WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND server_name = '$server' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Page life expectancy
panels.description: Seconds a page stays in the buffer pool. Sustained values below 300 s indicate memory pressure.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT collected_at AS time, ple_seconds AS "PLE"
                     FROM mon.memory_usage WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND server_name = '$server' ORDER BY 1

SELECT collected_at AS time, COALESCE(NULLIF(volume_mount_point, ''), 'data volume') AS metric,
                            free_pct AS value
                     FROM mon.disk_volume WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND server_name = '$server' ORDER BY 1

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(volume_mount_point, ''), 'data volume') AS volume, free_pct AS "Free %"
                   FROM mon.disk_volume WHERE server_name = '$server' AND collected_at = (SELECT max(collected_at) FROM mon.disk_volume WHERE server_name = '$server')

SELECT collected_at AS time, COALESCE(NULLIF(volume_mount_point, ''), 'data volume') AS metric,
                            free_mb / 1024.0 AS value
                     FROM mon.disk_volume WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND server_name = '$server' ORDER BY 1

SELECT collected_at AS time, counter_name AS metric, cntr_value AS value
                     FROM mon.perf_counter
                     WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND server_name = '$server' AND counter_name IN ('Memory Grants Pending', 'Blocked Requests')
                     ORDER BY 1

SELECT db_name, state_desc, recovery_model, total_size_mb, data_size_mb, log_size_mb,
                       last_full_backup, last_log_backup, log_reuse_wait
                FROM mon.db_inventory WHERE server_name = '$server' AND collected_at = (SELECT max(collected_at) FROM mon.db_inventory WHERE server_name = '$server') AND db_name = ANY(string_to_array('${db:csv}', ','))
                ORDER BY total_size_mb DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT collected_at AS time, db_name AS metric, total_size_mb AS value
                     FROM mon.db_inventory WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND server_name = '$server' AND db_name = ANY(string_to_array('${db:csv}', ',')) ORDER BY 1

SELECT collected_at AS time, db_name || ' / ' || filegroup_name AS metric, sum(used_mb) AS value
                     FROM mon.db_file_usage
                     WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND server_name = '$server' AND db_name = ANY(string_to_array('${db:csv}', ',')) AND filegroup_name <> '(log)'
                     GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT db_name, filegroup_name, filegroup_type, file_name, file_type, size_mb, used_mb,
                       round(100.0 * used_mb / NULLIF(size_mb, 0), 1) AS used_pct, max_size_mb, growth_desc,
                       physical_name
                FROM mon.db_file_usage WHERE server_name = '$server' AND collected_at = (SELECT max(collected_at) FROM mon.db_file_usage WHERE server_name = '$server') AND db_name = ANY(string_to_array('${db:csv}', ','))
                ORDER BY db_name, filegroup_name, file_name

SELECT collected_at AS time, db_name AS metric, used_log_pct AS value
                     FROM mon.db_log_usage WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND server_name = '$server' AND db_name = ANY(string_to_array('${db:csv}', ',')) ORDER BY 1

SELECT db_name, schema_name || '.' || table_name AS "table", row_count, reserved_mb, data_mb, index_mb
                FROM mon.table_usage WHERE server_name = '$server' AND collected_at = (SELECT max(collected_at) FROM mon.table_usage WHERE server_name = '$server') AND db_name = ANY(string_to_array('${db:csv}', ','))
                ORDER BY reserved_mb DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT collected_at AS time, db_name || '.' || table_name AS metric, reserved_mb AS value
                     FROM mon.table_usage
                     WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND server_name = '$server' AND db_name = ANY(string_to_array('${db:csv}', ','))
                       AND (db_name, schema_name, table_name) IN (
                           SELECT db_name, schema_name, table_name FROM mon.table_usage
                           WHERE server_name = '$server' AND collected_at = (SELECT max(collected_at) FROM mon.table_usage WHERE server_name = '$server') ORDER BY reserved_mb DESC LIMIT 10)
                     ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Fragmented indexes (latest nightly scan)
panels.description: Rule of thumb: 10-30 % reorganize, above 30 % rebuild. Indexes under 1000 pages are skipped.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT db_name, schema_name || '.' || table_name AS "table", index_name, index_type,
                       page_count, size_mb, avg_fragmentation_pct
                FROM mon.index_fragmentation
                WHERE server_name = '$server' AND collected_at = (SELECT max(collected_at) FROM mon.index_fragmentation WHERE server_name = '$server') AND db_name = ANY(string_to_array('${db:csv}', ',')) AND avg_fragmentation_pct >= 10
                ORDER BY avg_fragmentation_pct DESC, page_count DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Average fragmentation per database
panels.description: One point per nightly scan - widen the time range to 7 days.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT collected_at AS time, db_name AS metric, avg(avg_fragmentation_pct) AS value
                     FROM mon.index_fragmentation WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND server_name = '$server' AND db_name = ANY(string_to_array('${db:csv}', ','))
                     GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Batch requests / sec
panels.description: The counter is cumulative; this panel plots the delta between two samples.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, CASE WHEN dv >= 0 THEN dv / NULLIF(ds, 0) END AS "batch requests/sec"
                     FROM (SELECT collected_at AS time,
                                  cntr_value - lag(cntr_value) OVER w AS dv,
                                  extract(epoch FROM collected_at - lag(collected_at) OVER w) AS ds
                           FROM mon.perf_counter
                           WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND server_name = '$server' AND counter_name = 'Batch Requests/sec'
                           WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY collected_at)) x
                     ORDER BY 1

SELECT collected_at AS time, counter_name AS metric, cntr_value AS value
                     FROM mon.perf_counter
                     WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND server_name = '$server' AND counter_name IN ('Active User Sessions', 'User Connections', 'Blocked Requests')
                     ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Page reads / writes per sample
panels.description: Cumulative counters, shown as the delta between two 15-minute samples.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, counter_name AS metric, CASE WHEN dv >= 0 THEN dv END AS value
                     FROM (SELECT collected_at AS time, counter_name,
                                  cntr_value - lag(cntr_value) OVER (PARTITION BY counter_name ORDER BY collected_at) AS dv
                           FROM mon.perf_counter
                           WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND server_name = '$server' AND counter_name IN ('Page reads/sec', 'Page writes/sec', 'Lazy writes/sec')) x
                     WHERE dv IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Wait time per interval (top 8 waits, seconds)
panels.description: sys.dm_os_wait_stats is cumulative since instance start, so raw values only ever grow. This panel shows the time actually spent waiting in each interval.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, wait_type AS metric, CASE WHEN dv >= 0 THEN dv / 1000.0 END AS value
                     FROM (SELECT collected_at AS time, wait_type,
                                  wait_time_ms - lag(wait_time_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY wait_type ORDER BY collected_at) AS dv
                           FROM mon.wait_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND server_name = '$server') x
                     WHERE dv IS NOT NULL
                       AND wait_type IN (SELECT wait_type FROM mon.wait_stats
                                         WHERE server_name = '$server' AND collected_at = (SELECT max(collected_at) FROM mon.wait_stats WHERE server_name = '$server')
                                         ORDER BY wait_time_ms DESC LIMIT 8)
                     ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Availability groups (latest)
panels.description: Shows one explanatory row on instances that do not use Always On Availability Groups.

targets.rawSql:
WITH cur AS (
                    SELECT ag_name, replica_server_name, role_desc, connected_state_desc, replica_sync_health,
                           db_name, db_sync_state, db_sync_health, log_send_queue_kb, redo_queue_kb, is_suspended
                    FROM mon.ha_status WHERE server_name = '$server' AND collected_at = (SELECT max(collected_at) FROM mon.ha_status WHERE server_name = '$server'))
                SELECT * FROM cur
                UNION ALL
                SELECT 'No Availability Groups configured on this instance'::text, NULL::text, NULL::text, NULL::text,
                       NULL::text, NULL::text, NULL::text, NULL::text, NULL::bigint, NULL::bigint, NULL::integer
                WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cur)
                ORDER BY ag_name, replica_server_name, db_name

panels.title: Failed collector runs
panels.description: Zero-filled: a flat line at 0 means no collector failures in the selected range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT g.t AS time, COALESCE(f.n, 0) AS "failed runs"
                     FROM generate_series(date_bin(interval '15 minutes', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, TIMESTAMPTZ '2000-01-01'),
                                          $__timeTo()::timestamptz, interval '15 minutes') AS g(t)
                     LEFT JOIN (SELECT date_bin(interval '15 minutes', collected_at, TIMESTAMPTZ '2000-01-01') AS b, count(*) AS n
                                FROM mon.etl_run_log WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND server_name = '$server' AND status = 'FAILED' GROUP BY 1) f ON f.b = g.t
                     ORDER BY 1

SELECT collected_at AS time, metric, extract(epoch FROM finished_at - started_at) AS value
                     FROM mon.etl_run_log WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND server_name = '$server' AND finished_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

SELECT collected_at AS time, metric, rows_loaded AS value
                     FROM mon.etl_run_log WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND server_name = '$server' AND status IN ('SUCCESS', 'PARTIAL') ORDER BY 1

SELECT metric, last_ok_at, round(extract(epoch FROM age)) AS age_seconds, failures_24h
                FROM mon.v_data_freshness WHERE server_name = '$server' ORDER BY metric
